For example, Equatorial Guinea’s student visa overstay rate is 70.18%, while Chad’s B-1/B-2 overstay hit 49.54%—clear evidence of systemic abuse.

The Supreme Court already upheld similar measures in 2018, proving their legality. This isn’t about ethnicity; it’s about enforcing immigration laws that Biden’s administration ignored, leading to chaos like the 2021 Haitian migrant crisis.
